title: SieveScript/query args
description: Arguments for SieveScript/query (RFC 9661). Returns an ordered list of SieveScript ids matching a filter. Evaluated in memory over the account's scripts.

accountId.description: The account to query scripts from.

anyOf.description: A FilterOperator combining conditions with AND, OR or NOT.

filter.description: Filter: a SieveScriptFilterCondition (name: case-insensitive contains; isActive: Boolean) or a FilterOperator over such conditions. Null or omitted returns all scripts.

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (name or isActive), optional isAscending (default true) and optional collation. Supported collations: i;unicode-casemap (the default), i;ascii-casemap and i;octet; any other is unsupportedSort.

position.description: 0-based index of the first result to return.

anchor.description: A SieveScript id to anchor the result page at.

anchorOffset.description: Offset from the anchor (may be negative).

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return. A negative value is invalidArguments.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of matching scripts.
